body_text:
Additivity over intervals. If $f$ is Riemann integrable on $[a,b]$
and $c\in[a,b]$, then $\int_a^b f=\int_a^c f+\int_c^b f$. With the
conventions $\int_b^a f=-\int_a^b f$ and $\int_a^a f=0$, this
identity is independent of the order of the endpoints.
